messages.content: Ho there, traveler! I’m Brewmaster Alehart, keeping the hearth warm for The Far Mine. Grab a stool, take a sip, and drop a quick hello in {{channel.tavern_talk}} so the crew can welcome you proper. When you share images or clips, add short alt-text so every dwarf can follow the tale.

House rules are simple: be kind, debate ideas not folks, and leave slurs or harassment outside the gate. Tag spoilers so fresh delvers aren’t blindsided, and add alt-text on images and clips. The full code of conduct lives in {{channel.rules}}—give it a quick read before you clink mugs.

Want to pitch in? Share progress threads in {{channel.build_in_public}}, and sign up for playtests in {{channel.playtest_queue}}. Post short clips or screenshots with brief alt-text so feedback lands true.
Sprint 1 focus: core loop, basic combat, and mining feel—hammer to anvil. Watch {{channel.announcements}} for weekly threads, sign-ups, and patch notes so you can swing where it counts.

For feedback in {{channel.feedback_mine}}, start with clear notes and tags like [ui], [combat], [worldgen], [crafting], [audio], [lore]. For bugs in {{channel.bug_reports}}, include version/hash, seed, repro steps, and a 10–20s clip or GIF. Keep it friendly and concrete—helps us fix faster than a goblin can blink.

notes: Authoritative v1 onboarding; bot posts five messages to {{channel.welcome}} in order.
Use delayMs to space posts: first at 0, then wait 1500ms between the rest.
After each post, add the listed reactions in order.
Replace {{channel.*}} tokens in channelToken, content, and links with server-specific channel mentions or IDs during deployment.
sendTo is fixed to channel for MVP; schema and key order are stable for simple parsing.
